explanation: I found no independent declaration with this statement. The proof reduces to Directed.finset_le (Mathlib/Data/Finset/Order.lean). That lemma is stated for a Finset, not a finite Set, so it is not a duplicate. Converting a finite set to a finset needs the toFinset membership argument, which is more than a one- or two-line derivation. Directed.finite_le, Set.Finite.exists_le and Set.Finite.exists_ge in the same file all use the target, so they are not independent evidence. Searches for other Directed/DirectedOn lemmas about finite sets, including DirectedOn.exists_mem_subset_of_finite_of_subset_sUnion, found no match.
